Chants of Sennaar es un juego de aventuras y puzles desarrollado por Rundisc y distribuido por Focus Entertainment. Ha recibido grandes elogios por parte de la crítica y el premio al Mejor Juego Independiente en los New York Game Awards 2024, además de diversas nominaciones a otros premios como los BAFTA y The Game Awards.
 
 Divididos desde el albor de los tiempos, aislados por miedo o desconfianza, los pueblos de la torre ya no se hablan. Mas cuenta la leyenda que un viajero sabrá derribar los muros y recuperar el equilibrio. Recorre los infinitos caminos de un laberinto prodigioso, averigua la verdad y desvela los misterios de este universo fascinante en el que antiguos idiomas son tanto puerta como llave.

 Descubre una enorme y enigmática torre inspirada en el mito de Babel. Encarna al viajero y sumérgete en un mundo lleno de misterios donde las gentes se han distanciado y ya no son capaces de comunicarse entre ellas. Empieza la aventura en una torre prodigiosa habitada por cinco pueblos diferentes, observa, escucha e intenta rehacer los vínculos que ha roto la desconfianza.

 Disfruta de un ingenioso sistema de juego, explora y resuelve puzles para revelar los secretos de cinco idiomas distintos pero relacionados. Con la ayuda de tu fiel cuaderno, toma nota de cada símbolo, lleva un registro del entorno, habla con la gente y desentraña el significado de los glifos. Cada paso será un peldaño en el ascenso a la torre y cada palabra un eslabón en los vínculos entre las gentes.

 Sumérgete en un lugar colorido y cautivador lleno de secretos. Lánzate a un mundo hermoso inspirado por prestigiosos autores de cómic europeos en el que cada nivel de la torre cuenta con una identidad visual propia y una tecnología, arquitectura y cultura características. Emprende un viaje apasionante y poético con una banda sonora lírica y conmovedora compuesta por Thomas Brunet.

Nommé meilleur jeu indépendant aux New York Game Awards 2024 et nominé à de nombreuses reprises lors d'autres événements (notamment The Game Awards et les BAFTA), Chants of Sennaar est un jeu d'aventure à énigmes salué par la critique. Il est développé par Rundisc.
 
 Divisés depuis la nuit des temps, isolés par la peur ou la méfiance, les Peuples de la Tour ne se parlent plus. On dit qu'un jour, un voyageur d'une grande sagesse brisera ces murs de défiance et rétablira l'équilibre. Grimpez les escaliers interminables d'un extraordinaire labyrinthe, découvrez la vérité et levez le voile sur les mystères de cet univers fascinant où les langues anciennes constituent à la fois des obstacles et des solutions. 

 Découvrez une tour aussi imposante qu'énigmatique dans ce jeu qui s'inspire du mythe de la Tour de Babel. Dans le rôle du Voyageur, plongez dans un monde de mystères où les peuples se sont éloignés les uns avec les autres, au point de ne plus pouvoir communiquer entre eux. Commencez l'aventure dans cette tour prodigieuse habitée par cinq peuplades très différentes. Observez, écoutez et faites tout votre possible pour rétablir la confiance d'autrefois.

 Avec son gameplay astucieux, le jeu vous permettra d'explorer les lieux et de résoudre diverses énigmes pour élucider les mystères de cinq langues à la fois distinctes et liées les unes aux autres. Prenez des notes sur les symboles et l'environnement dans votre fidèle carnet, engagez la conversation avec différentes personnes et découvrez la signification de tous les glyphes. À chaque pas qui vous rapprochera du sommet de la tour, les mots vous permettront de rétablir les liens entre les peuples.

 Plongez-vous dans un monde haut en couleur regorgeant de secrets. Explorez des environnements sublimes qui s'inspirent de bandes dessinées européennes, chaque étage de la tour ayant une identité visuelle, un niveau technologique, une architecture et une culture qui lui sont propres. Embarquez-vous dans un voyage poétique et enchanteur au son d'une bande originale lyrique et émouvante composée par Thomas Brunet.

Das bei den New York Game Awards 2024 als bestes Indie-Spiel ausgezeichnete und bei anderen Preisverleihungen wie The Game Awards und BAFTA mehrfach nominierte Chants of Sennaar ist ein von der Kritik hochgelobtes Rätsel- und Abenteuerspiel, das von Rundisc entwickelt wurde.
 
 Die seit Anbeginn der Zeit durch Angst und Misstrauen voneinander isolierten Völker des Turms kommunizieren nicht mehr miteinander. Es heißt, dass eines Tages ein Reisender die Weisheit finden wird, die Mauern niederzureißen und das Gleichgewicht wiederherzustellen. Erklimme die endlosen Stufen eines gewaltigen Labyrinths, entdecke die Wahrheit und lüfte die Geheimnisse dieses faszinierenden Universums, in dem die uralten Sprachen Schlüssel und Schloss zugleich sind.

 Erkunde einen gewaltigen vom Mythos von Babel inspirierten Turm voller Rätsel. Als Reisender tauchst du in eine geheimnisvolle Welt ein, in der sich die Völker immer weiter voneinander entfernt haben und nicht mehr in der Lage sind, sich zu verständigen. Beginne dein Abenteuer in einem riesigen Turm, der von fünf verschiedenen Völkern bewohnt wird. Beobachte, lausche und versuche, die vom Misstrauen zerrissenen Bande wiederherzustellen.

 Erkunde den Turm und löse unterschiedliche Rätsel mithilfe eines intelligenten Spielsystems, um die Geheimnisse fünf miteinander verbundener Sprachen zu lüften. Dein treuer Begleiter ist dabei das Notizbuch, in dem du jedes gefundene Symbol notierst. Behalte deine Umgebung im Auge, unterhalte dich mit den Bewohnern und entziffere die Bedeutung aller Glyphen. Mit jedem entschlüsselten Wort stellst du die Verbindung zwischen den Völkern wieder her und kommst der Spitze des Turms ein Stück näher.

 Eine mitreißende, farbenfrohe Welt voller Geheimnisse und Rätsel erwartet dich. Stürze dich kopfüber in eine wunderschöne Spielumgebung, die sich an einflussreichen europäischen Comics orientiert. Jede Ebene des Turms besitzt ihre eigene visuelle Identität, die sich in Form einzigartiger Technologien, Architektur und Kultur äußert. Begib dich auf ein zauberhaftes Abenteuer, das mit einem gefühlvollen lyrischen Soundtrack von Thomas Brunet unterlegt ist.

Vincitore del premio Best Indie Game ai New York Game Awards del 2024 e plurinominato in altre premiazioni tra cui The Game Awards e i BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar è un gioco di avventura e rompicapi acclamato dalla critica, sviluppato da Rundisc.
 
 Separati fin dall'alba del tempo, i Popoli della Torre non comunicano più gli uni con gli altri, isolati dalla paura o dalla sfiducia. Si dice che un giorno verrà un Viaggiatore, e la sua saggezza abbatterà le barriere e ristabilirà l'equilibrio. Viaggia per le scalinate interminabili di un prodigioso labirinto, scopri la verità e svela i misteri di questo universo affascinante in cui le lingue antiche sono insieme chiave e serratura. 

 Scopri una torre enigmatica e vasta, ispirata al mito di Babele. Nei panni del Viaggiatore, esplora un mondo pieno di misteri, dove i Popoli si sono allontanati, ormai incapaci di comunicare tra loro. Inizia la tua avventura in una torre prodigiosa abitata da cinque diversi Popoli: osserva, ascolta e fai ogni sforzo per rinsaldare i legami spezzati dalla sfiducia.

 Grazie al sistema di gameplay intelligente, esplora e risolvi diversi enigmi per scoprire i misteri di cinque diverse lingue interconnesse tra loro. Sotto la guida costante del tuo fedele diario, annota ogni simbolo, tieni traccia dell'ambiente circostante, conversa con le persone e svela il significato di ciascun glifo. Ogni passo in avanti ti porterà verso la vetta della Torre, e ogni parola rinsalderà i legami tra i Popoli.

 Immergiti in un mondo appassionante e pittoresco, colmo di segreti. Tuffati in un mondo magnifico ispirato ai maestri del fumetto europeo dove ciascun piano della Torre ha una sua identità visiva, con tecnologie, architetture e culture ben distinte. Parti per un viaggio poetico e ammaliante accompagnato da una colonna sonora che risuona in fondo all'anima, realizzata da Thomas Brunet.

传说有一天，旅行者将重聚无法相互交流的塔中人民。在受巴别塔神话启发的迷人宇宙中观察，聆听和破译古代语言。

高塔上的各个民族语言不通由来已久，传说某个旅人某日将破除隔阂，将他们团结起来。走进这座别样而又迷人的巴别塔，仔细观察、聆听，才能破译古代文字。

《Chants of Sennaar》

寻觅往昔的只言片语，揭示过去的秘密 

自从创世之初，高塔各族便已分隔，彼此不再有言语往来，只是据说某日，某位旅人获得了智慧，能够推倒高墙，恢复天道。走进引人入胜的世界，探索缤纷诗意的设定，感受巴别塔传说的奇妙，帮人们忆起往事。置身庞大的迷宫之中，走过无穷无尽的阶梯，揭示苦涩的真相，揭晓迷人世界的秘密。在这里，你会发现：古老的语言既是锁头，也是钥匙。

踏上别有天地的旅途，破译有趣的古代文字 

- 探索美妙而又迷人的世界，体验扎实的叙事，以不同的形式领略巴别塔的神话
- 仔细观察周围环境，破解谜题，揭开身边的秘密
- 利用潜行和智慧巧胜卫兵，穿过常人不可入内的禁区
- 破译古代文字，令高塔各族恢复联系与交流

game.brief:
Winner of Best Indie Game at the 2024 New York Game Awards and nominated multiple times at other ceremonies including The Game Awards and the BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar is a critically-acclaimed puzzle and adventure game developed by Rundisc.
 
 Divided since the dawn of time, the Peoples of the Tower no longer speak to each other, isolated by fear or mistrust. It is said that one day, a Traveler will find the wisdom to break down the walls and restore the balance. Travel the endless steps of a prodigious labyrinth, uncover the truth and unveil the mysteries of this fascinating universe where ancient languages are both the lock and the key.

 Inspired by the myth of Babel, discover an enigmatic and vast tower. As the Traveler, delve into a world full of mysteries, where Peoples have grown distant, unable to communicate with each other anymore. Begin your adventure in a prodigious tower inhabited by five distinct Peoples, observe, listen, and strive to mend the bonds of distrust. 
  
 With a smart gameplay system, explore and solve various puzzles to uncover the mysteries of five different interconnected languages. Always guided by your trusty notebook, note each symbol, keep track of your surroundings, engage in conversations with people and unravel the meaning of every glyph. Each step will pave your way to the top of the Tower as each word will restore the link between People.
  
 Dive into an enthralling and colorful world full of secrets. Tumble headlong into a beautiful world inspired by impactful European comics authors where every floor of the Tower possesses its own visual identity, supported by distinctive technological levels, architecture and culture. Embark on a poetic and enchanting journey driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack, made by Thomas Brunet.

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
game.description:
An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule awaits in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom for Nintendo Switch. The adventure is yours to create in a world fueled by your imagination.

In this sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you'll decide your own path through the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule and the mysterious islands floating in the vast skies above. Can you harness the power of Link's new abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom?

While exploring the caves underneath Hyrule Castle to investigate the origins of the gloom (a dangerous substance which appeared all over the kingdom), Link and Zelda not only find old archeological remains of the Zonai, an ancient race said to have descended from the sky, but also an maleficent mummy held by a bodiless arm, who suddenly reanimates, defeats Link, breaks the Master Sword and rise large structures, once found underground, to the skies above Hyrule, with Zelda vanishing with a spark from a strange amulet found on the site.
Some time later, Link awakens in an unknown place on a floating sky island and meets a mysterious spirit called Rauru, which transplanted his arm (the same arm which was holding the mummy) onto Link, since his right arm was beyond saving. Guided by this new ally, Link sets out in an adventure to protect Hyrule, find Princess Zelda and uncover the mysteries of the Zonai.

无尽的冒险，扩张至无垠的天空。《塞尔达传说 旷野之息》续篇登场。

广阔无垠的“大地”，接下来更扩张至浮云之上的“天空”——在这个世界里，所往之处、所做之事，一切皆由自己作主。要在空中穿梭翱翔，或是在不可思议的空岛进行探索？还是要运用林克手中的全新力量，迎战海拉鲁的异变？专属于你的无尽冒险，再度启程。
《塞尔达传说 王国之泪》（日语：ゼルダの伝説 ティアーズ オブ ザ キングダム，英语：The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom）是一款由任天堂企划制作本部开发并由任天堂发行在任天堂Switch上的开放世界动作冒险游戏。本作于2019年E3直面会上正式公布，于2023年5月12日发售，发售后获得业界高度好评，多家媒体给予满分评价。

game.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
game.description:
Trained from early childhood and mutated to gain superhuman skills, strength, and reflexes, witchers are a counterbalance to the monster-infested world in which they live.

• Gruesomely destroy foes as a professional monster hunter armed with a range of upgradeable weapons, mutating potions, and combat magic.
• Hunt down a wide variety of exotic monsters, from savage beasts prowling mountain passes to cunning supernatural predators lurking in the shadowy back alleys of densely populated cities.
• Invest your rewards to upgrade your weaponry and buy custom armor, or spend them on horse races, card games, fist fighting, and other pleasures life brings.
  
Built for endless adventure, the massive open world of The Witcher sets new standards in terms of size, depth, and complexity.

• Traverse a fantastical open world: explore forgotten ruins, caves, and shipwrecks, trade with merchants and dwarven smiths in cities, and hunt across the open plains, mountains, and seas.
• Deal with treasonous generals, devious witches, and corrupt royalty to provide dark and dangerous services.
• Make choices that go beyond good & evil, and face their far-reaching consequences.
  
Take on the most important contract of your life: to track down the child of prophecy, the key to saving or destroying this world.

• In times of war, chase down the child of prophecy, a living weapon foretold by ancient elven legends.
• Struggle against ferocious rulers, spirits of the wilds, and even a threat from beyond the veil – all hell-bent on controlling this world.
• Define your destiny in a world that may not be worth saving.

  Updated to the latest version, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt comes with new features and items, including a built-in Photo Mode, swords, armor, and alternate outfits inspired by The Witcher Netflix series — and more!

《巫师3：狂猎》将是三部曲系列的最后一作，故事将有宏大的最后结局，但并非《巫师》系列的最终作。本作采用最新的REDengine3引擎制作，玩家可以在无缝的世界里任意探索，采用非线性剧情的设定，整体规模是前作的30倍。

《巫师3：狂猎》是一款由波兰游戏工作室CD Projekt RED开发并发行的开放世界动作角色扮演游戏，于2013年2月公布。游戏于2015年5月19日在Microsoft Windows、PlayStation 4和Xbox One平台发布，这也是首款在PlayStation平台发布的巫师系列游戏。

本作是巫师系列的第三部作品，同样改编自波兰奇幻小说作家安杰伊·萨普科夫斯基的同名系列小说（中译《猎魔人》），但剧情发生在小说之后。游戏在商业上取得了成功并受到了广泛的赞誉，在六周内销量超过600万，亦获得2015年游戏大奖的最佳年度游戏，以及最佳角色扮演游戏。

本作是一款情节驱动的开放世界角色扮演游戏。故事发生在一个令人目眩神迷的奇幻宇宙里，玩家做出的每一个选择都意义重大，同时也要面对影响深远的后果。在《巫师》这个广袤的开放世界中，您可以尽情探索商业都市、海盗岛屿、危险的山隘和被遗忘的洞窟。而随着北方领域战乱四起，您接下了此生最为重大的一笔委托：找到预言之子，一件足以改变世界面貌的活生生的武器。

◇ 扮演一名训练有素，收钱办事的怪物杀手
猎魔人身处的世界怪物横行。作为一支制衡力量，他们自小接受训练，通过变异来获得超人类的战斗技巧、力量和反应。
扮演一名职业怪物杀手，装备一系列可以升级的武器、变种魔药和战斗法术，无情地把对手大卸八块。
凶残的野兽徘徊于山间，狡猾的灵异掠食者潜伏在人烟稠密的城镇暗处，而您则要捕杀这些各色的奇异怪物。
把您赚取的奖赏用来升级武器，购买订制的盔甲，或者花在赛马、打牌、拳击，还有其它的夜间娱乐生活上。

◇ 探索道德沦丧的开放式奇幻世界
巫师宏大的开放世界为玩家带来无尽的冒险，并且在规模、深度和复杂性等方面树立了新的标准。
遍历奇幻的开放世界：探索被遗忘的废墟、洞穴和沉船，与城市里的商人和矮人工匠做买卖，在开阔的平原、山地和海洋上进行狩猎。
与谋反的将领、阴险的女巫还有腐败的皇室打交道，替他们去完成见不得光的危险勾当。
做出超越善恶的选择，直面影响深远的后果。

◇ 追寻预言之子
接下最为重要的一笔委托，追寻预言之子。那是一个可以拯救或是摧毁这个世界的关键。
根据古代精灵的预言，预言之子强大无比，是一件活生生的武器。而您则要在纷飞的战火中找到对方的下落。
和一心想要控制这个世界的残暴统治者、野外的精怪，乃至于来自来世的威胁斗智斗勇。
在这个或许并不值得拯救的世界里，左右自己的命运。

◇ 次世代机能的全面发挥
专为次世代硬件量身打造的 REDengine 3，把《巫师》的逼真奇幻世界渲染得细腻生动。
动态的天气系统和日夜循环，将会改变城镇居民以及野外怪兽的行为模式。
通过主线和支线的丰富剧情选择，玩家可以通过前所未有的方式，影响这个宏大的开放世界。

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red.

Set in a dark fantasy world, the game follows Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter searching for his adopted daughter, Ciri, while navigating political conflicts and supernatural threats. Gameplay features exploration, combat, character progression, and branching narratives shaped by player choices. Widely acclaimed for its writing, world-building, and depth, it is considered one of the most influential RPGs of its generation.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt concludes the story of the witcher Geralt of Rivia, the series' protagonist, whose story to date has been covered in the previous installments. Geralt's new mission comes in dark times as the mysterious and otherworldly army known as the Wild Hunt invades the Northern Kingdoms, leaving only blood soaked earth and fiery ruin in its wake; and it seems the Witcher is the key to stopping their cataclysmic rampage.

  Infos zum Spiel  Eines der preisgekröntesten Rollenspiele aller Zeiten Jetzt bereit für die neue Generation.
   
  Du bist Geralt von Riva, Monsterschlächter und Söldner. Vor dir erstreckt sich ein vom Krieg zerrütteter und von Monstern befallener Kontinent, den du nach Belieben erkunden kannst. Dein aktueller Auftrag? Finde Ciri, das Kind der Prophezeiung – eine lebende Waffe mit der Macht, die Welt zu verändern.
  
  Mit dem Update auf die neueste Version beinhaltet The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt neue Features und Extras wie den integrierten Fotomodus, neue Gegenstände (Schwerter, Rüstung, alternative Outfits), die von der Netflix-Serie The Witcher inspiriert wurden, und noch mehr!
  
   
  Erlebe die düstere Fantasy-Welt des Kontinents wie nie zuvor! Diese Edition von The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt beinhaltet zahlreiche grafische und technische Verbesserungen, darunter viel höhere Detaildichte, mehrere neu entwickelte oder von der Community geschaffene Mods, Echtzeit-Raytracing und mehr – alles mit Blick auf die Leistungsstärke modernder PCs umgesetzt!
  
   
  Hexer wurden seit ihrer Kindheit trainiert und durchliefen Mutationen, um übermenschliche Fähigkeiten, Stärke und Reflexe zu erlangen – nur so haben sie eine Chance gegen die Monster ihrer Welt.
  • Zerstöre deine Gegner als professioneller Monsterjäger, der mit verschiedenen Waffen, Mutationstränken und Kampfmagie ausgestattet ist.
  • Jage eine Vielzahl exotischer Monster, von wilden Bestien an Bergpässen bis hin zu gerissenen übernatürlichen Raubtieren, die in den dunklen Gassen dicht besiedelter Städte lauern.
  • Nutze deine Belohnungen, um deine Waffen zu verbessern und besondere Rüstungen zu kaufen, oder gib dein Geld für Pferderennen, Kartenspiele, Faustkämpfe und sonstige Unterhaltung aus.
  
   
  Die riesige Open World von The Witcher bietet dir endlose Abenteuer und setzt neue Maßstäbe, was Größe, Tiefe und Komplexität angeht.
  • Durchquere eine fantastische Welt: Erkunde vergessene Ruinen, Höhlen und Schiffswracks, handle mit Kaufleuten und zwergischen Schmieden in Städten und jage auf Ebenen, in Bergen und auf dem Meer.
  • Triff auf hinterhältige Generäle, verschlagene Hexen und korrupte Adlige, denen du gefährliche Dienste anbietest.
  • Triff Entscheidungen, die nicht einfach gut oder böse sind und weitreichende Konsequenzen haben.
  
   
  Nimm den wichtigsten Auftrag deines Lebens an – finde das Kind der Prophezeiung, das die Welt retten oder zerstören wird.
  • Spüre mitten im Krieg das Kind der Prophezeiung auf, eine lebende Waffe aus uralten elfischen Legenden.
  • Tritt gnadenlosen Herrschern, Naturgeistern und sogar einer Bedrohung von jenseits des Schleiers entgegen – die allesamt diese Welt kontrollieren wollen.
  • Bestimme dein Schicksal in einer Welt, die es nicht verdient, gerettet zu werden.

game.title: Pokémon Yellow Version: Special Pikachu Edition
game.description:
Pokémon Yellow is an enhanced version of Pokémon Red and Blue that allows you to start the game with your very own Pikachu following you around on-foot and collect the 3 other starters from strangers you meet around the region. However, your goal remains the same: catch them all and become the ultimate Pokémon Master.

Like Pokémon Red and Blue, Yellow takes place in the region of Kanto, which features habitats for 151 Pokémon species. The objectives remain the same as well, though some differences exist along the way. For example, in the beginning, the player is not given an option of choosing one of three starters. Instead, a wild Pikachu that Professor Oak catches becomes player's Pokémon, while the rival character takes an Eevee that was intended for the player. The plot takes from the anime, and features characters that were not featured in the game or have been enhanced to resemble their anime characters, including Jessie, James, Meowth, Nurse Joy and Officer Jenny. Similar to the anime, Pikachu refuses to evolve. Players are also given the opportunity to obtain the original three starters. As players quest on, they collect more Pokémon and use them to defeat the eight Gym Leaders and eventually the Elite Four, all the while battling Team Rocket, a gang devoted to using Pokémon in order to make themselves more powerful.

game.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Deluxe Edition
game.description:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a ground-breaking turn-based RPG with unique real-time mechanics, making battles more immersive and addictive than ever. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France in which you battle devastating enemies.

Get the ultimate Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 experience with the Deluxe Edition!
The Deluxe Edition includes:

·Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Base Game
·The “Flowers” Collection - Six outfits and hairstyles inspired by the Flowers of Lumière, along with six additional “Gommage” outfit variations. One for each playable character.
·“Clair” - A custom outfit for Maelle
·“Obscur” - A custom outfit for Gustave

“Year by year, She erases us.”

Once a year, the Paintress wakes and paints upon her monolith. Paints her cursed number. And everyone of that age turns to smoke and fades away. Year by year, that number ticks down and more of us are erased. Tomorrow she’ll wake and paint “33.” And tomorrow we depart on our final mission - Destroy the Paintress, so she can never paint death again.

We are Expedition 33.

game.title: PEAK
game.description:
PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
     
WORK TOGETHER 
Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.
  
CLIMB 
The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully — every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.
  
SURVIVE 
Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you.
  
A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY 
The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.
  
EARN BADGES 
A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.
  
CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS 
Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts through Steam to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're  really  brave!

FEATURES    
• Climb with a total of 4 friends
• Communicate through proximity chat       
• 4 different biomes to ascend through
• A bunch of questionable foods
• Lots of different climbing items
• Campfires and marshmallows   
• Character customization    
• Online co-op and offline single player    
• Ghosts

• Character customization

game.brief:
PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
     
WORK TOGETHER 
Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.
  
CLIMB 
The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully — every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.
  
SURVIVE 
Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you.
  
A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY 
The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.
  
EARN BADGES 
A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.
  
CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS 
Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts through Steam to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're  really  brave!

FEATURES    
• Climb with a total of 4 friends
• Communicate through proximity chat       
• 4 different biomes to ascend through
• A bunch of questionable foods
• Lots of different climbing items
• Campfires and marshmallows   
• Character customization    
• Online co-op and offline single player    
• Ghosts

game.title: Death Road to Canada
game.description:
Death Road to Canada is a Randomly Generated Road Trip Simulator. You control and manage a car full of jerks as they explore cities, recruit weird people, argue with each other, and face gigantic swarms of slow zombies.
 
 Death Road is built for replay value. Everything is randomized: locations, events, survivor appearances and personalities. There's a different story every time you play, set in a world that doesn't take itself too seriously.
 
 Death Features:
   Up to 500 zombies can hunt you down at a time. Fight them, try to squirm past, or run.
   Use the character creator to put yourself, friends, and family in the game. Have them show up at random to get eaten!
   Find special and rare events, weapons, and characters with strange abilities.
   Make tough choices in Interactive Fiction events. Get different options and results based on the traits of your party members.
   Teach a dog how to drive a car.
   Throw chairs. Get your characters strong enough to throw large sofas.
   Most family friendly zombie apocalypse game on the market! Any gore explosion is in a cute style. We censor the word d*ngus once.
   Tell people to "Cool it."
   4 player local same screen co-op where you control up to 4 characters!

Death Road to Canada is a Permadeath Randomized Road Trip Simulator. You manage a group of survivors through decision making events as you travel from Florida to Ontario, Canada. This is mixed in with exploring, sneaking around, or fighting in randomly generated cities and other locations.

Scavenge for supplies, find survivors, and deal with massive hordes of classic-style zombies. game.title: LoneStar
game.description:
LoneStar is a strategic Roguelike spaceship combat game. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain bounty rewards and vacations. Find the treasures, customize your spaceship, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you!

localized_description.text:
LoneStar is a strategic Roguelike spaceship combat game. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain bounty rewards and vacations. Find the treasures, customize your spaceship, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you!

Update Journal      
 
 
  About the Game  Attention! My fellow Bounty Hunters,  
  
   The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you! Join us now! 
  
       
  The Association provides the following benefits:  
  
     
  Both sides accumulate Power for their own spaceship and compete in a fair shockwave battle to determine who the winner is! This is the recognized way of battle in the LONESTAR Universe, without any surprise attacks!
  
       
     
     
  All hunters who join the Association will receive a free spaceship! 
  
  Each spaceship has its own expertise and possesses nearly a hundred exclusive units! (Note: The Association only provides initial units; other units need to be obtained by hunters during their journey.)
  
       
     
     
  As the largest Bounty Hunter organization in the LONESTAR Universe, the Association has dozens of spaceship pilots!
  
  The Association guarantees that each pilot has undergone repeated tests, with unique exclusive skills and a vast array of random talents, ensuring that each hunting experience is unique.
  
  Furthermore, the Association's recruitment work is ongoing, and there will be a continuous influx of new pilots in the future.
  
       
     
     
  The Association strictly adheres to the LONESTAR Universe Labor Protection Act and provides generous vacations for all Bounty Hunters.
  
  Every time you complete a Bounty Mission, the Association will offer a period of paid leave.
  
  During your vacation, you will encounter various unique events, make choices, and obtain resources. So, please enjoy your vacation time!
  
       
     
     
  In the LONESTAR Universe, there are hundreds of different treasures, each with a unique function. Coupled with various exclusive units and different spaceships, such a wide variety of combinations may have left you overwhelmed.
  
  No worries! The Association's Information Center has collected data on most of the units and Treasures in the universe and compiled them into an encyclopedia for your reference! It will undoubtedly assist you in creating a unique build!
  
       
     
     
  The Association's Intelligence Center has gathered information on nearly a hundred wanted criminals in the LONESTAR Universe, including 15 extremely dangerous boss-level felons! You can access the criminal information before each mission and adjust your combat strategies accordingly. The Association's Intelligence Center will help you secure victory!
  
  For any newly wanted criminals that may appear in the future, we will announce their profiles in Notices. Please check regularly.

Update Journal      
 
 
  Acerca del juego  Attention! My fellow Bounty Hunters,  
  
   The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you! Join us now! 
  
       
  The Association provides the following benefits:  
  
     
  Ambos bandos acumulan poder para sus propias naves espaciales y compiten en una batalla de ondas de choque para determinar quién es el ganador. Es la forma reconocida de las batallas en el universo de LONESTAR, ¡sin ataques sorpresa!
  
       
     
     
  ¡Todos los cazadores que se unan a la Association recibirán una nave espacial gratis!
   
  
  ¡Cada nave tiene su propio nivel de dominio y cuenta con casi un centenar de unidades exclusivas! (Aviso: la Association solo proporciona las unidades iniciales; las demás las tienen que conseguir los cazadores en su aventura).
  
       
     
     
  Al ser la organización de cazarrecompensas más grande del universo de LONESTAR, la Association cuenta decenas de pilotos de naves.
  
  De hecho, garantiza que cada uno de sus pilotos habrá superado repetidas pruebas y dispondrá de habilidades exclusivas únicas y una gama amplia de talentos aleatorios, con lo que asegura que cada experiencia de caza sea única.
  
  Además, la maquinaria de reclutamiento de la Association funciona a la perfección, por lo que habrá una afluencia continua de nuevos pilotos en el futuro.
  
       
     
     
  La Association se adhiere estrictamente a la Ley de Protección Laboral del universo de LONESTAR y ofrece vacaciones generosas a todos los cazarrecompensas.
  
  Siempre que completes una misión, la Association te ofrecerá tiempo de vacaciones pagadas.
  
  Durante tus vacaciones, te encontrarás con eventos únicos, tomarás decisiones y conseguirás recursos. ¡Disfruta fuera del trabajo!
  
       
     
     
  En el universo de LONESTAR, hay centenares de tesoros diferentes, cada uno de los cuales tiene una función única. Es posible que esta abundancia de combinaciones, unida a la existencia de unidades exclusivas y diferentes naves espaciales, te haya abrumado un poco.
  
  ¡No te preocupes! El Information Center de la Association ha recopilado datos sobre la mayoría de las unidades y tesoros del universo, y los ha utilizado para elaborar una enciclopedia de consulta. ¡Puedes tener la certeza de que te ayudará a crear una configuración única!
  
       
     
     
  El Intelligence Center de la Association ha recopilado datos sobre casi un centenar de criminales buscados en el universo de LONESTAR, ¡incluidos 15 que son extremadamente peligrosos! Puedes acceder a la información sobre los criminales antes de cada misión para poder ajustar las estrategias de combate según corresponda. ¡El Intelligence Center de la Association te ayudará a conseguir la victoria!
  
  En el caso de los nuevos criminales que puedan aparecer en un futuro en la lista de más buscados, sus perfiles se anunciarán en la sección Notices. Échales un vistazo con frecuencia.

Update Journal      
 
 
  À propos du jeu  Attention! My fellow Bounty Hunters,  
  
   The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you! Join us now! 
  
       
  The Association provides the following benefits:  
  
     
  Chacun accumule des pouvoirs pour son vaisseau spatial et vous vous affrontez dans un combat Shockwave qui déterminera le vainqueur ! C'est la seule façon officielle de se battre dans l'univers de LONESTAR. Finies les attaques surprises !
  
       
     
     
  Tous les chasseurs de prime qui rejoignent les rangs de l'Association reçoivent un vaisseau spatial gratuit ! 
  
  Chaque vaisseau a ses propres spécialités et possède près d'une centaine d'unités exclusives ! (Remarque : l'Association ne fournit que les unités initiales ; c'est à vous d'obtenir les autres unités au fil de votre aventure.) 
  
       
     
     
  Plus grande organisation de chasseurs de prime de l'univers LONESTAR, l'Association dispose de dizaines de pilotes de vaisseaux !
  
  L'Association garantit que chaque pilote a réussi une série de tests, développé des compétences exclusives et une large gamme de talents aléatoires, ce qui rend chaque expérience de chasse unique.
  
  En outre, l'Association poursuit son travail de recrutement, et vous verrez apparaître de nouveaux pilotes à l'avenir.
  
       
     
     
  L'Association adhère à la réglementation sur la protection des travailleurs de l'univers LONESTAR et offre de nombreuses plages de congés à tous les chasseurs de prime.
  
  Chaque fois que vous décrochez une prime, l'Association vous offre une période de congés payés.
  
  Pendant vos vacances, vous vivrez des événements variés originaux, vous devrez faire des choix, et vous pourrez obtenir des ressources. Alors, profitez bien de vos vacances !
  
       
     
     
  Dans l'univers LONESTAR, il existe des centaines de trésors différents, chacun doté d'une fonction particulière. Associez-les avec des unités exclusives et différents vaisseaux. Les combinaisons sont si nombreuses, que vous en aurez la tête qui tourne.
  
  Mais ne vous en faites pas ! Le centre d'information de l'Association a recueilli des données sur la plupart des unités et des trésors de l'univers et les a compilées pour vous dans une encyclopédie de référence ! Voilà qui vous aidera sûrement à créer un vaisseau unique en son genre !
  
       
     
     
  Le centre de renseignements de l'Association a rassemblé des informations sur près d'une centaine de délinquants recherchés dans l'univers LONESTAR, notamment 15 criminels extrêmement dangereux de niveau boss ! Vous pouvez accéder aux renseignements sur ces criminels avant chaque mission et adapter votre stratégie de combat en conséquence. Avec le centre de renseignements de l'Association, la victoire sera à vous !
  
  Si de nouveaux criminels recherchés apparaissent ultérieurement, nous vous préviendrons de la mise à disposition de leurs profils. Restez bien à l'affût.

Update Journal      
 
 
  Infos zum Spiel  Attention! My fellow Bounty Hunters,  
  
   The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you! Join us now! 
  
       
  The Association provides the following benefits:  
  
     
  Beide Seiten sammeln Energie für das eigene Raumschiff und treten dann in einem Schockwellenkampf gegeneinander an, den nur einer gewinnen kann! Dies ist die anerkannte Art des Kampfes im LONESTAR-Universum, Überraschungsangriffe gibt es nicht!
  
       
     
     
  Alle Jäger, die der Organisation beitreten, erhalten ein kostenloses Raumschiff!
   
  Jedes Raumschiff verfügt über seine eigene Spezialisierung und wartet mit fast einhundert exklusiven Einheiten auf! (Hinweis: Die Organisation stellt nur die anfänglichen Einheiten bereit – weitere Einheiten müssen die Jäger auf ihrer Reise selbst erwerben.) 
  
       
     
     
  Die Organisation ist die größte Kopfgeldjägerorganisation im gesamten LONESTAR-Universum und beschäftigt Dutzende von Raumschiffpiloten!
  
  Die Organisation garantiert, dass jeder Pilot wiederholte Tests bestanden hat, einzigartige, exklusive Fähigkeiten besitzt und über ein breites Spektrum an zufälligen Talenten verfügt, sodass jedes Jagderlebnis absolut einzigartig ist.
  
  Außerdem fährt die Organisation mit der Rekrutierung von Piloten fort, sodass auch künftig kontinuierlich neue Piloten hinzukommen werden.
  
       
     
     
  Die Organisation respektiert das Arbeitsschutzgesetz des LONESTAR-Universums und bietet allen Kopfgeldjägern großzügige Urlaubsansprüche.
  
  Für jeden abgeschlossenen Kopfgeldeinsatz gewährt dir die Organisation einen bezahlten Urlaub.
  
  Während deiner freien Tage erlebst du eine Vielzahl einzigartiger Ereignisse, triffst Entscheidungen und sammelst Ressourcen. Viel Spaß im Urlaub!
  
       
     
     
  Im LONESTAR-Universum gibt es Hunderte von unterschiedlichen Schätzen – und jeder davon hat eine einzigartige Funktion. In Kombination mit diversen exklusiven Einheiten und verschiedenen Raumschiffen ist eine so große Vielfalt an Möglichkeiten leicht überwältigend.
  
  Aber keine Sorge! Das Informationszentrum der Organisation hat Daten über die meisten Einheiten und Schätze im Universum gesammelt und sie in einer Enzyklopädie für dich zusammengestellt! Dort wirst du mit Sicherheit Hilfe finden, um einen einzigartigen Build zu erschaffen!
  
       
     
     
  Das Geheimdienstzentrum der Organisation hat Daten über fast einhundert gesuchte Straftäter im LONESTAR-Universum zusammengetragen, darunter 15 äußerst gefährliche Schwerverbrecher auf Boss-Ebene! Vor jeder Mission hast du die Möglichkeit, die Informationen über die Verbrecher abzurufen und deine Kampfstrategien entsprechend anzupassen. Das Geheimdienstzentrum der Organisation wird dir zum Sieg verhelfen!
  
  Sollten in Zukunft weitere Straftäter auf die Fahndungsliste gesetzt werden, veröffentlichen wir ihre Profile in den Hinweisen. Bitte achte regelmäßig auf Neuigkeiten.

game.title: Her Love, Like Poison
game.description:
A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late one night, where she meets an enchanting raven-haired femme fatale - but all is not as it seems.

Ethel Briggs is a shy, self-conscious girl in her final year of university. Though she should be working on her thesis about Romantic poetry, her well of inspiration has run dry. After a nasty break-up with her former girlfriend, Clementine, Ethel is feeling very blue - and it certainly doesn't help that she's spending the winter holidays in the depressingly drab village of Oxbury, while her family are off holidaying in sunny Australia.

Left to her own devices, Ethel struggles to finish her thesis while the cold, wintry wind blows outside and the days continue to get shorter and darker.

Staying inside proves to be unbearable, however, and Ethel escapes the confines of her family's home for a breath of fresh air. Going for a walk in the woods should be enough to invigorate her, and fill her with newfound passion for Romanticism.

That was Ethel's plan, at least - but she wasn't counting on meeting a mysterious, dark-haired beauty in the woods, who is much more than she seems.

game.title: Reverse: 1999
game.description:
Reverse: 1999 sets in the retro style world in the west. The story is interesting: on the last day of 1999, humanity was brought into a new age – the 1920s, by a strange storm. In the new world, surprisingly, some talented people have a kind of ability called Arcanum, and some of them become Arcanists. You will explore and try to discover the secrets in the new world.

Now you must find out what to do and save some people along the way. It’s a fantastic card-based game in which you’ll learn a lot of new stuff that RPG fans will undoubtedly enjoy.

Now you must find out what to do and save some people along the way. It’s a fantastic card-based game in which you’ll learn a lot of new stuff that RPG fans will undoubtedly enjoy.

On the last day of 1999, the "Storm" fell upon the world. You witnessed an era reversed beneath the rising raindrops. Defying all reasons, what unfolds in front of you is the world of an era long past. 
  As the Timekeeper, observer of eras, you are free to travel through these eras after each "Storm." With the aid of Sonetto, a powerful Arcanist and ally from the Foundation, your mission is to travel through eras to where the "Storm" is most active, find other Arcanists who can sense the coming "Storm," and save them from being "sifted out" of the timeline. 
  ▶▶Stunning Visuals Blending Retro and Modern Aesthetics◀◀ 
  Step into the mysterious alt-history animated by unique visual elements that blend Pop Art, classical oil painting, and more art styles in history.  
  ▶▶A Cinematic Adventure across the 20th Century◀◀  
  From the Roaring '20s to the turn of the millennium, you will embark on a journey across time and space, and uncover the truth about the "Storm" and the mystery of the year 1999. 
  
  ▶▶Full English Voice Acting with Authentic Accents◀◀  
  Immerse yourself in ages past. Enjoy a story performed by diverse cast of voice actors with British, Italian, French, and other accents.  
  ▶▶Fantastic Arcanists from Different Times and Regions◀◀ 
  People once called them "mages," "wizards," and "freaks." Now they live in uneasy coexistence with regular humans … But who are the Arcanists, really? 
  ▶▶Weave Arcane Incantations to Attain Glorious Victories◀◀ 
  Build your team, cast spells, and use gorgeous arcane skills to defeat your enemies. Begin your exciting adventure through time in this all-new RPG.

game.title: Down in Bermuda
game.description:
An unnatural storm leaves an adventurous aviator stranded for decades within the infamous Bermuda. Overcome creatures of the deep and unravel the islands secrets in search for a way back home.
 

 
Down in Bermuda is a quirky adventure filled with puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover. Our adventurous aviator Milton finds himself trapped in a time bubble deep inside the Bermuda and needs your help to escape. 
 

 
Crack codes, solve puzzles, collect magic orbs and escape each of the six unique islands, each one leading to the next on a quest for a way back home.
 

 
From the studio who brought you the suave secret agent adventure Agent A: A puzzle in disguise.

localized_description.text:
一场反常的风暴，让一名喜欢冒险的飞行员被困在臭名昭著的百慕大群岛长达几十年。战胜深渊里的生物，揭开岛屿秘密，寻找回家之路。
 

 
《逃出百慕大》是一场奇特的冒险之旅，途中布满了亟待解决的谜题和等候揭开的奥秘。我们富有冒险精神的飞行员米尔顿，发现自己被困在百慕大群岛地底深处的时间泡泡中，需要你的帮助才能逃脱。
 

 
破解密码，解开谜题，收集魔法球，逃离六个独特，但在寻找回家之路途中环环相扣的岛屿。
 

 
风格独具的秘密特工冒险游戏《Agent A：伪装游戏》开发工作室最新力作。

一場意外的暴風，讓一名愛冒險的飛行員在惡名昭彰的百慕達受困長達數十年。戰勝深淵裡的生物並揭開島嶼的秘密，找到回家的路。
 

 
《逃出百慕達》是一款古靈精怪的冒險遊戲，充滿著解謎關卡和各種秘密，就等玩家來破解。我們愛冒險的飛行員米爾頓，發現自己被困在百慕達地底的時光泡泡中，需要你的協助才能逃脫。
 

 
不畏艱難踏上回家之路，破解密碼、解開謎題、收集魔法球並逃離六座不同的島嶼。
 

 
風格獨具的秘密特務冒險遊戲《Agent A：偽裝遊戲》開發工作室最新力作。

An unnatural storm leaves an adventurous aviator stranded for decades within the infamous Bermuda. Overcome creatures of the deep and unravel the islands secrets in search for a way back home.
 

 
Down in Bermuda is a quirky adventure filled with puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover. Our adventurous aviator Milton finds himself trapped in a time bubble deep inside the Bermuda and needs your help to escape. 
 

 
Crack codes, solve puzzles, collect magic orbs and escape each of the six unique islands, each one leading to the next on a quest for a way back home.
 

 
From the studio who brought you the suave secret agent adventure Agent A: A puzzle in disguise.

Una tormenta inesperada deja a un aviador aventurero aislado durante décadas en las infames Bermudas. Vence a las criaturas del fondo del mar y descubre los secretos de las islas para poder volver a casa.
 

 
Down in Bermuda es una extravagante aventura repleta de puzles y misterios que resolver. Milton, nuestro aviador aventurero, se encuentra encerrado en una burbuja temporal en lo más profundo de las Bermudas, y necesita tu ayuda para escapar. 
 

 
Descifra códigos, resuelve puzles, consigue orbes mágicos y huye de las seis islas; cada una te llevará a la siguiente hasta que regreses a casa.
 

 
Del estudio creador de la sofisticada aventura de agentes secretos Agent A: A puzzle in disguise.

Suite à une tempête inhabituelle, un aviateur intrépide se retrouve livré à lui-même au sein des Bermudes pendant des dizaines d'années. Affronte les créatures des abysses et perce les mystères des îles afin de pouvoir rentrer chez toi.
 

 
Down in Bermuda est une aventure loufoque et truffée d'énigmes à résoudre et de mystères à percer. Milton, un aviateur intrépide, se retrouve coincé dans une bulle temporelle en plein cœur des Bermudes et il a besoin de toi pour s'échapper. 
 

 
Déchiffre des codes, résous des énigmes, ramasse des orbes magiques et échappe-toi des six îles originales les unes après les autres pour tenter de rentrer chez toi.
 

 
Issu du studio qui a apporté le charmant jeu d'aventure d'agent secret Agent A: A puzzle in disguise.

Aufgrund eines ungewöhnlich heftigen Sturms sitzt ein Pilot für Jahrzehnte im berühmt berüchtigten Bermuda-Dreieck fest. Überwältige Kreaturen der Tiefe, decke die Geheimnisse der Insel auf und finde so deinen Weg zurück nach Hause.
 

 
Down in Bermuda ist ein schrulliges Abenteuer voller Rätsel, die es zu lösen und Geheimnisse, die es aufzudecken gilt. Unser abenteuerlustiger Pilot Milton findet sich in einer Zeitblase im Bermuda-Dreieck gefangen wieder. Nun ist es an dir, ihm bei seiner Flucht zu helfen. 
 

 
Entschlüssele Codes und löse Rätsel, sammle magische Kugeln und entkomme von allen der sechs einzigartigen Inseln. Jede dieser Inseln bringt dich auf deiner Reise nach Hause ein Stück näher ans Ziel.

Down in Bermuda is a quirky adventure filled with puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover. Our adventurous aviator Milton finds himself trapped in a time bubble deep inside the Bermuda and needs your help to escape. 
 

 
Crack codes, solve puzzles, collect magic orbs and escape each of the six unique islands, each one leading to the next on a quest for a way back home.
 

 
From the studio who brought you the suave secret agent adventure Agent A: A puzzle in disguise.

スパイアドベンチャー『Agent A：A puzzle in disguise』の開発スタジオがお届けします。

game.title: A Hat in Time
game.description:
A Hat in Time is a cute-as-heck 3D platformer featuring a little girl who stitches hats for wicked powers. A little girl and her spaceship In A Hat in Time you play as a tiny space-travelling girl with a big tophat. Her adventure is halted when all her fuel, the Time Pieces, is lost and scattered across a nearby planet. Hat Kid must now jump, fight and stitch new hats to make her way into every nook and cranny of this new world in order to restore her fuel and resume her journey. On her way, she'll bump into the menacing Mafia of Cooks, the goofy birds of Dead Bird Studio, the spooky shadows of Subcon Forest, and more! Murder on a train! Parades! Trespassing in a movie studio? Every mission in A Hat in Time is unique! At one moment you'll be solving the  Murder on the Owl Express  by finding clues and interrogating the locals, the next moment you'll be the band marshal in  The Big Parade , or sneaking through the bird-run  Dead Bird Studio !
 
        Small child, giant worlds Jump freely around in 5 massive worlds with new adventures to discover around every corner! Just like any child, Hat Kid loves to climb and explore, no mountain is too big for her sense of adventure. She can do multiple jump moves, as well as climb walls, and swing over gaps! Cute hats, magical yarn and snappy badges By finding and collecting rare magical yarn, Hat Kid can stitch new cute hats with a variety of abilities, including a witch hat that allows her to cook explosive concoctions, and a wooden ghost mask that allows her to peek into other dimensions. Hats can become even more powerful, by attaching badges that are found, sold and traded by the locals! Community-funded, community-focused A Hat in Time was successfully funded on Kickstarter, reaching nearly 10 times its goal! In order to celebrate our community, A Hat in Time is releasing with full modding and Steam Workshop support, an in-game screenshot mode, and more!

A Hat in Time est un jeu de plateformes super-choupi où une petite fille doit tricoter ses propres chapeaux tous dotés de pouvoirs totalement déments ! Une petite fille et son vaisseau A Hat in Time te met dans les chaussures d'une jeune voyageuse de l'espace coiffée d'un haut-de-forme. Son aventure se trouve brusquement interrompue car le carburant de son vaisseau, les Fragments Temporels, se sont écrasés sur une planète voisine. Elle doit maintenant utiliser son vaste arsenal de mouvements et de chapeaux afin d'explorer ce monde inconnu dans ses moindres recoins pour pouvoir reprendre son voyage. Sur sa route, elle croisera de nombreux personnages, tel que la Mafia des Cuistots, les oiseaux des Studios Dead Bird,  les menaçants autochtones de la Forêt Onirique, et plus encore ! Enquêter dans un train ! Des parades ! S'infiltrer dans un studio de cinéma ? Chaque mission de A Hat in Time est unique ! Entre résoudre  Le Meurtre de l'Owl Express , mener  La Grande Parade , et devoir vous infiltrer dans les  Studios Dead Bird , vous ne saurez plus sur quel pied danser !
 
        Une petite fille dans un vaste monde Bondissez librement dans 5 mondes gigantesques, où l'aventure vous attend à chaque virage ! Comme n'importe quel enfant, cette petite fille adore courir de partout, aucune montagne n'est insurmontable pour elle.  Sa vaste panoplie de sauts lui permet d'aller où bon lui semble ! Pelotes magiques, badges et autres chapeaux mignons En trouvant les pelotes cachées dans les mondes, de nouveaux chapeaux, tous avec leur propres pouvoirs vous deviendront accessible, la coiffe  de alchimiste vous permettra de jeter des concoctions explosives, un masque à l'allure flippante vous permettre de jeter un bref coup œil  dans une autre dimension. Les chapeaux peuvent même être améliorés, en achetant des badges aux habitants de chaque monde ! Le communautaire mis en avant A Hat in Time a été rendu possible par Kickstarter, atteignant près de 10 fois sa somme initiale ! Pour célébrer cela, il est désormais possible de modder A Hat in Time, qui a son propre Steam Workshop, mais aussi de prendre ses propres photos, et plus encore !

game.title: Half Step Princess
game.description:
toxic teenage lesbian romance in XXXXXXX, ontario, with swords

A  half step  is an action where the fencer makes a partial advance or retreat moving just one foot forward or back. It's an essential bit of footwork, useful to make a feint, or extend and delay one's preparation before an attack.

  ✤ ⚔︎ ✤

   It's 2011 in Ontario. We're all growing up. The future is bright. The  sun is going down. Girls take the bus home. Blades are drawn.

  Gwendolyn Baker ,   grade ten, is the new student in her fencing club. Shy and petite, an only child, she's never been very talented at sports, and she finds herself lost and frozen in the shadow of a city which seems to be fading away.

 Despite her anxieties, delinquent  Charlotte  (club ace and her upperclassman),  Joanna  (standoffish private school princess), and  Hannah Abigail  (know-it-all beauty) all set eyes on her. A haze of suburban angst and foiled romances hangs over the autumn landscape while Gwen falls into a canopy of bitter rivalries.

 ✿ ♕ ✿

 ~30k words of toxic teenage yuri, 3 months of autumn, 5 bouts, 4 closeted lesbians, 2 tournament arcs. 

  ✤ ☁ ✤

 Inspired by 60s-70s sports anime, Ontario gothic, 80s-90s shoujo,  English modernism, and 00s-10s digital nostalgia, with a dreamy original  soundtrack by   In Love With a Ghost   and art by   Madeline Miyun

  
 ✾ ♛ ✾

 Written, drawn, and composed in six weeks for   Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2

 ✤ ✝ ✤

   Historical Notes

  More than two-thirds of the population of Canada lives in the suburbs.

  From 2005 to 2009, tens of thousands of jobs were cut in the automotive industry in Ontario.

  In 2004, the City of Kitchener announced a strategic Economic Development Investment Fund to "modernize the city's business community."

  Since 1957, the University of Waterloo cooperative education program has grown to become one of the largest co-op programs in the world, with over 20,000 students enrolled today. An enormous number of those students are in the School of Computer Science.

  My bus ride home from school in Kitchenener-Waterloo took me around two hours, one way. As of 2019, KW's ION Light Rail now runs (part of) that route. I still haven't rode it.

  About a third of my high school graduating class went onto study CS. Or Engineering. Or Business, at Laurier.

  Since a dip in 1996, the average price of a home in the Greater Toronto Area has increased from around $200k to nearly $1.2m (Canadian dollars, of course).

  A study by Statistics Canada in 2026 found the Kitchener-Waterloo-Cambridge tri-city to have one of the highest unemployment rates. Small cities across Ontario have been reported as some of the worst places for job seekers in various articles and job studies over the last decade.

  The Ontario Fencing Association did not release a policy clarifying rules regarding transgender athletes until 2019.

  This story is not set in Kitchener.

  There should be no requirement for an athlete to disclose their transgender identity or history to compete in high performance sport (up to the point where international federation rules would take effect)  unless there is a justified reason to do so.

 Despite her anxieties, delinquent  Charlotte  (club ace and her upperclassman),  Joanna  (standoffish private school princess), and  Hannah Abigail  (know-it-all beauty) all set eyes on her. A haze of suburban angst and foiled romances hangs over the autumn landscape while Gwen falls into a canopy of bitter rivalries.

 ✿ ♕ ✿

 ~30k words of toxic teenage yuri, 3 months of autumn, 5 bouts, 4 closeted lesbians, 2 tournament arcs. 

  ✤ ☁ ✤

 Inspired by 60s-70s sports anime, Ontario gothic, 80s-90s shoujo,  English modernism, and 00s-10s digital nostalgia, with a dreamy original  soundtrack by   In Love With a Ghost   and art by   Madeline Miyun

  
 ✾ ♛ ✾

 Written, drawn, and composed in six weeks for   Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2

 ✤ ✝ ✤

   Historical Notes

  More than two-thirds of the population of Canada lives in the suburbs.

  From 2005 to 2009, tens of thousands of jobs were cut in the automotive industry in Ontario.

  In 2004, the City of Kitchener announced a strategic Economic Development Investment Fund to "modernize the city's business community."

  Since 1957, the University of Waterloo cooperative education program has grown to become one of the largest co-op programs in the world, with over 20,000 students enrolled today. An enormous number of those students are in the School of Computer Science.

  My bus ride home from school in Kitchenener-Waterloo took me around two hours, one way. As of 2019, KW's ION Light Rail now runs (part of) that route. I still haven't rode it.

  About a third of my high school graduating class went onto study CS. Or Engineering. Or Business, at Laurier.

  Since a dip in 1996, the average price of a home in the Greater Toronto Area has increased from around $200k to nearly $1.2m (Canadian dollars, of course).

  A study by Statistics Canada in 2026 found the Kitchener-Waterloo-Cambridge tri-city to have one of the highest unemployment rates. Small cities across Ontario have been reported as some of the worst places for job seekers in various articles and job studies over the last decade.

  The Ontario Fencing Association did not release a policy clarifying rules regarding transgender athletes until 2019.

  This story is not set in Kitchener.

  There should be no requirement for an athlete to disclose their transgender identity or history to compete in high performance sport (up to the point where international federation rules would take effect)  unless there is a justified reason to do so.

game.title: Caravan SandWitch
game.description: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure game.

localized_description.text: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure game.

In Caravan SandWitch, embark on a journey across a Sci-Fi Provence-like world, driven by a mystery through your missing sister that unfolds with each step you take.
 
       
 Interact with the communities on Cigalo, help them with their tasks and meet new people along the way. Take your time to explore the world, whether in your van or on foot.
 
 Life is simple: no combat, no death, no timer, just you, your van, and the world.  Explore a Provence-like World        
 Equipped with your van and an array of essential tools, you set out on a quest to find your missing sister. Upgrade your van throughout your adventure and explorations to open up new passages and ruins. From navigating treacherous terrain to uncovering ancient ruins, every step of your journey brings you closer to unraveling the truth behind your sister's disappearance.  A hopeful Post-Apocalypse        
 From a green planet to a desertic one due to human activities and sur-exploitation; discover on Cigalo the impact of humans and its population through your road trip. Meet the Reinetos, an old aboriginal species, the Robots left behind after the planet exploitation, the humans who stayed after everyone left for another planet, and the mysterious SandWitch. All of them live peacefully in Cigalo and help each other in this unwelcome environment.  Meet a diverse cast of characters        
 As you interact with the diverse characters you meet along the way, you'll come to understand that your community is your home.
 
 Help everyone and contribute your piece to the edifice, enabling everyone to live in harmony in an environment hostile to all civilizations due to over-exploitation.  A Game developed for All  Plane Toast made huge importance to create a game in which everyone can feel included, representing their vision of a world where communities help each other to overcome the environmental consequences of our world.  
 
 Caravan SandWitch is written with an inclusive script, that represents a real community with its people and representation.  
 
  Accessibility options are available.

En Caravan SandWitch, emprenderás un viaje a través de un mundo de ciencia ficción de estilo provenzal, impulsado por el misterio de la desaparición de tu hermana, el cual se va desentramando con cada paso que das.
 
       
 Interactúa con las comunidades de Cigalo, ayúdalos con sus tareas y conoce a gente nueva por el camino. Tómate tu tiempo para explorar el mundo, ya sea en tu caravana o a pie.
 
 La vida es simple: sin combate, sin muerte, sin cronómetro, solo tú, tu caravana y el mundo.  Explora un mundo de estilo provenzal        
 Equipado con tu caravana y una variedad de herramientas esenciales, emprenderás una búsqueda para encontrar a tu hermana desaparecida. Mejora tu caravana a lo largo de tu aventura y exploración para desbloquear nuevos pasajes y ruinas. Desde navegar por terrenos traicioneros hasta descubrir ruinas antiguas, cada paso de tu viaje te acercará más a desentrañar la verdad sobre la desaparición de tu hermana.  Un posapocalipsis esperanzador         
 De un planeta verde a uno desértico debido a las actividades humanas y la sobreexplotación, descubre en Cigalo el impacto de los humanos y a sus habitantes a través de tu viaje por carretera. Conoce a los Reinetos, una antigua especie aborigen, a los robots que quedaron atrás después de la explotación del planeta, a los humanos que permanecieron cuando todos se fueron a otro planeta y a la misteriosa SandWitch. Todos ellos viven pacíficamente en Cigalo y se ayudan mutuamente en estas tierras inhóspitas.  Conoce a un elenco diverso de personajes        
 A medida que interactúas con los diversos personajes que conoces por el camino, llegarás a comprender que tu comunidad es tu verdadero hogar.
 Ayuda a los demás y aporta tu parte al edificio, lo que permite a todos vivir en armonía en un entorno hostil para todas las civilizaciones por culpa de la sobreexplotación.  Un juego desarrollado para todos  Plane Toast ha dado gran importancia a crear un juego en el que todos puedan sentirse incluidos, representando su visión de un mundo donde las comunidades se ayudan entre sí para superar las consecuencias ambientales de nuestro mundo.
 Caravan SandWitch está escrito con un guion inclusivo, que refleja una comunidad real con su gente y representación.
 
  También hay opciones de accesibilidad disponibles.

Caravan SandWitch vous propose de voyager dans un monde de science-fiction inspiré des paysages provençaux. À mesure de votre progression le mystère de votre sœur disparue vous servira de guide pour découvrir la vérité.
 
       
 Interagissez avec les communautés de Cigalo, aidez-les dans leurs tâches, et rencontrez de nouvelles personnes en chemin. Prenez aussi le temps d'explorer le monde, que ce soit à bord de votre van ou à pied.
 
 La vie est simple : ni combat, ni mort, et ni chronomètre. Dans Caravan SandWitch il n'y a que vous, votre van, et un monde à explorer.  Parcourez un monde inspiré des paysages provençaux        
 Avec pour équipement votre van et une panoplie d'outils, partez à la recherche de votre sœur disparue. Améliorez votre van tout au long de votre aventure et de vos explorations, afin d’accéder à de nouveaux passages et à de nouvelles ruines. De la navigation sur des terrains escarpés à la découverte de ruines anciennes, chaque étape de votre voyage vous rapproche un peu plus de la vérité sur la disparition de votre sœur.  Un univers post-apocalyptique plein d'espoir        
 Découvrez à travers votre traversée l'impact de la terraformation sur Cigalo, une planète désertique autrefois pleine de végétation. Rencontrez les Reinetos, une ancienne espèce aborigène, les Robots laissés sur place après l'exploitation de la planète, les humains qui sont restés après le départ de tous leurs semblables vers une autre planète, ainsi que la mystérieuse SandWitch. Tous vivent paisiblement sur Cigalo et s'entraident dans cet environnement hostile.  Rencontrez une multitude de personnages différents        
 Au fur et à mesure de vos interactions avec les différents personnages rencontrés en chemin, vous comprendrez que toute cette communauté est ce qui vous fait vous sentir chez vous. 
 Aidez tout le monde et apportez votre pierre à l'édifice, afin de permettre à chacun de vivre en harmonie dans un environnement rendu hostile à toute civilisation à cause de la surexploitation de ses ressources.  Un jeu développé à destination de tous  Plane Toast a mis un point d'honneur à créer un jeu dans lequel tout le monde peut se sentir inclus, et ce en représentant sa vision d'un univers où les communautés s'entraident pour surmonter les difficultés environnementales de notre monde. 
 Caravan SandWitch a été écrit sur la base d'un scénario inclusif qui décrit une communauté réelle, avec ses habitants et ses représentations. 
 
  En outre, des options d'accessibilité sont disponibles.

In Caravan SandWitch begibst du dich in einer Sci-Fi-Welt, die der Provence ähnelt, auf eine Reise, die von einem Geheimnis um deine verschwundene Schwester angetrieben wird und sich mit jedem deiner Schritte entfaltet.
 
       
 Interagiere mit anderen Gemeinschaften auf Cigalo, hilf ihnen bei ihren Aufgaben und triff neue Personen auf deinem Weg. Nimm dir Zeit, die Welt zu erkunden, sei es mit deinem Wohnmobil oder zu Fuß.
 
 Das Leben ist einfach: keine Kämpfe, kein Tod, kein Timer, nur du, dein Wohnmobil und die Welt.  Erkunde eine Provence-ähnliche Welt        
 Ausgestattet mit deinem Wohnmobil und einer Anzahl notwendiger Werkzeuge, begibst du dich auf die Mission, deine verschwundene Schwester zu finden. Verbessere dein Wohnmobil während deines Abenteuers und deiner Erkundungen, um neue Wege und Ruinen zu erschließen. Vom Navigieren durch tückisches Terrain zum Entdecken altertümlicher Ruinen bringt dich jeder Schritt auf deiner Reise der Wahrheit um das Verschwinden deiner Schwester näher.  Eine hoffnungsvolle Postapokalypse        
 Von einem grünen Planeten zu einer Wüstenlandschaft aufgrund menschlicher Aktivitäten und Übernutzung; entdecke auf Cigalo während deines Roadtrips den Einfluss der Menschheit und ihrer Bevölkerung. Triff die Reinetos, eine alte indigene Spezies, die Roboter, die nach der Ausbeutung des Planeten zurückgelassen wurden, die Menschen, die geblieben sind, nachdem alle auf einen anderen Planeten aufgebrochen sind, und die mysteriöse SandWitch. Sie alle leben friedlich auf Cigalo und helfen einander in dieser unwirtlichen Umgebung.  Triff eine diverse Besetzung von Figuren        
 Während du mit den diversen Figuren interagierst, die du auf deinem Weg triffst, wirst du verstehen, dass deine Gemeinschaft dein Zuhause ist.
 Hilf allen und steuere deinen Teil zum Bauwerk bei, das es allen erlaubt, in Harmonie zu leben, inmitten einer Umgebung, die wegen Übernutzung allen Zivilisationen gegenüber feindselig ist.  Ein Spiel, das für Alle entwickelt wurde  Plane Toast hat der Entwicklung eines Spiels, in dem sich alle zugehörig fühlen, größte Wichtigkeit gegeben, und ihre Vision einer Welt zum Leben erweckt, in der Gemeinschaften einander helfen, um die Auswirkungen auf die Umwelt in unserer Welt zu bewältigen.
 Caravan SandWitch ist mit einem inkludierenden Drehbuch geschrieben, das eine tatsächliche Gemeinschaft mit ihren Menschen und deren Repräsentation darstellt.
 
  Optionen für Barrierefreiheit sind verfügbar.

Tag på en rejse i Caravan SandWitch gennem en Provence-lignende sci-fi-verden, der drives af et mysterium om din forsvundne søster, og som udfolder sig, hver gang du tager et skridt.
 
       
 Interagér med samfundene i Cigalo, hjælp dem med deres opgaver, og mød nye mennesker på turen. Sæt tid af til at udforske verden, uanset om du kører i din autocamper eller til fods.
 
 Livet er enkelt: ingen kamp, ingen død, ingen timer. Der er kun dig, din autocamper og verden.  Udforsk en Provence-lignende verden        
 Du indleder i din autocamper og med et udvalg af vigtige værktøjer en søgen efter din forsvundne søster. Opgradér din autocamper under dit eventyr og efterforskning for at åbne nye veje og ruiner. Fra at navigere gennem vanskeligt terræn til at opdage ældgamle ruiner. Ethvert skridt på din rejse bringer dig nærmere afsløringen af sandheden bag din søsters forsvinden.  En håbefuld tid efter verdens undergang        
 Fra en grøn til en ørkenlignende planet skabt af menneskets aktiviteter og overdrevne udnyttelse. Opdag i Cigalo påvirkningen på mennesker og dets befolkning på din rejse. Mød Reinetos, der er en gammel indfødt stamme efterladt af robotterne efter udnyttelsen af planeten, menneskerne, der blev tilbage, da alle tog afsted til en anden planet, og den mystiske SandWitch. Alle lever fredeligt i Cigalo og hjælper hinanden i det barske miljø.  Mød en mangfoldig gruppe af karakterer        
 I takt med at du interagerer med disse forskellige karakterer, som du møder på din vej, får du en forståelse af, at dit samfund er dit hjem.
 
 Hjælp alle, og giv dit bidrag til projektet for at gøre det muligt for alle at leve harmonisk i et miljø, der er fjendtligt over for alle civilisationer på grund af den overdrevne udnyttelse.  Et spil, der er udviklet til alle  Det er meget vigtigt, at Plane Toast har udviklet et spil, hvor alle føler sig inkluderet, ved at præsentere deres vision af en verden, hvor samfundene hjælper hinanden med at overvinde de miljømæssige konsekvenser for vores verden. 
 Caravan SandWitch er skrevet med et inkluderende script, der udgør et ægte samfund med dets folk og repræsentation. 
 
  Tilgængelighedsindstillinger er til rådighed.

In Caravan SandWitch, intraprendi un viaggio in un mondo fantascientifico simile alla Provenza, mosso dal mistero della scomparsa di tua sorella che si svelerà passo dopo passo.
 
       
 Interagisci con le comunità di Cigalo, aiutale con le loro missioni e incontra nuove persone lungo la strada. Prendi il tempo necessario per esplorare il mondo, sia a bordo del camper che a piedi.
 
 La vita è semplice: nessun combattimento, nessuna morte, nessun cronometro. Solo tu, il tuo camper e il mondo.  Esplora un mondo simile alla Provenza        
 Grazie al tuo camper e a un arsenale di strumenti essenziali, parti alla ricerca di tua sorella scomparsa. Migliora il tuo camper procedendo nell’avventura ed esplorando, in modo da sbloccare nuovi passaggi e rovine. Dal superamento di terreni ostici alla scoperta di antiche rovine, ogni passo del tuo viaggio ti avvicinerà a scoprire la verità dietro alla scomparsa di tua sorella.  Uno scenario post-apocalittico pieno di speranza        
 Da un pianeta verde a uno desertico, causato dall’attività umana e dall’eccessivo sfruttamento; scopri l’impatto dell’uomo e della sua popolazione su Cigalo durante il tuo viaggio. Incontra i Reinetos, un’antica specie aborigena, i robot lasciati dopo lo sfruttamento del pianeta, gli umani che sono rimasti dopo che tutti sono partiti per un altro pianeta, e la misteriosa SandWitch. Tutti loro coesistono pacificamente su Cigalo, e si aiutano l’un l’altro in questo ambiente inospitale.  Incontra un insieme variegato di personaggi        
 Interagendo con i diversi personaggi che incontrerai lungo il viaggio, arriverai a capire che la tua comunità è la tua casa. 
 Aiutali tutti e contribuisci a costruire la comunità, che consentirà loro di vivere pacificamente in un ambiente ostile a tutte le civiltà a causa dell’eccessivo sfruttamento.  Un gioco sviluppato per il divertimento di tutti  Plane Toast ha dato grande importanza nel creare un gioco in cui tutti possano sentirsi inclusi, rappresentando la loro visione di un mondo dove le comunità si aiutano a vicenda per superare le problematiche ambientali del nostro mondo. 
 Caravan SandWitch è stato scritto con una sceneggiatura inclusiva, che rappresenta una comunità reale con le sue persone e le sue espressioni. 
 
  Sono disponibili opzioni di accessibilità.

game.title: Unpacking
game.description:
Unpacking is a zen puzzle game about the familiar experience of pulling possessions out of boxes and fitting them into a new home. Part block-fitting puzzle, part home decoration, you are invited to create a satisfying living space while learning clues about the life you’re unpacking.

Over the course of eight house moves, you are given a chance to experience a sense of intimacy with a character you never see and a story you’re never told.

Over the course of eight house moves, you are given a chance to experience a sense of intimacy with a character you never see and a story you’re never told. Discover a character's story through the items that come with her to each new home (and the items that get left behind).

Unpacking is a zen game about the familiar experience of pulling possessions out of boxes and fitting them into a new home. Part block-fitting puzzle, part home decoration, you are invited to create a satisfying living space while learning clues about the life you’re unpacking. Over the course of eight house moves, you are given a chance to experience a sense of intimacy with a character you never see and a story you’re never told.
 
       
 
  Features 
   Unpack a home — from a single bedroom to an entire house
   Meditative gameplay with no timers, meters or scores
   Explore domestic environments with all their nooks and crannies while you stack plates, hang towels, and arrange bookshelves
   Discover a character's story through the items that come with her to each new home (and the items that get left behind)
   Soundtrack by BAFTA award-winning composer and audio director Jeff van Dyck

Unpacking es un juego relajante acerca del sentimiento familiar de sacar pertenencias de cajas para colocarlas en un nuevo hogar. Mitad juego de bloques, mitad juego de decoración, podrás crear habitaciones agradables mientras descubres pistas de la vida que estás desempacando. A lo largo de ocho mudanzas, tendrás la oportunidad de experimentar una sensación de intimidad con un personaje que no ves y con una historia que no te cuentan.
 
       
 
  Características 
   Desempaca un hogar: de una cama sencilla a una casa entera.
   Mecánica de juego meditativa sin cronómetros, medidores o puntajes.
   Explora ambientes domésticos con todos sus recovecos mientras apilas platos, cuelgas toallas y organizas estanterías.
   Descubre la historia de un personaje a través de los objetos que la acompañan a cada nueva vivienda (y aquellos que quedan atrás).
   Banda sonora creada por el compositor y director de sonido ganador del BAFTA, Jeff van Dyck.

Unpacking est un jeu zen sur l'expérience familière de sortir ses affaires de cartons et de les placer dans une nouvelle maison. Moitié puzzle de placement de blocs, moitié décoration d'intérieur, venez créer un espace de vie agréable tout en découvrant des indices sur la vie que vous déballez. Au fil des huit déménagements dans de nouvelles maisons, vous aurez l'opportunité de vivre un sentiment d'intimité avec un personnage que vous ne verrez jamais et une histoire dont vous ne savez rien.
 
       
 
  Fonctionnalités : 
   Déballez une maison, d'une simple chambre à une maison entière
   Style de jeu méditatif sans score, décompte, ni chronomètre
   Explorez des environnements domestiques avec tous leurs petits recoins tout en empilant les assiettes, en pendant les serviettes et en arrangeant les bibliothèques
   Découvrez l'histoire d'un personnage au travers des objets qui se trouvent dans chaque nouvelle maison (et ceux qui sont abandonnés)
   Musique par le compositeur et directeur audio récompensé aux BAFTA, Jeff van Dyck

Unpacking ist ein entspannendes Spiel über das vertraute Erlebnis, seine Besitztümer aus einem Karton zu holen und einen Platz in einem neuen Zuhause für sie zu finden. Das Spiel bietet eine Mischung aus Bausteinpuzzle und Heimdekoration und lädt dich dazu ein, es dir gemütlich zu machen und dabei etwas über das Leben zu erfahren, das du hier auspackst. Im Lauf von acht Umzügen lernst du eine Figur kennen, die du nie zu sehen bekommst und deren Geschichte nicht erzählt wird.
 
       
 
  Features 
   Packe ein Zuhause aus – von einem Zimmer hin zu einem ganzen Haus
   Meditatives Spielen ohne Zeitdruck, Fortschrittsleisten oder Punktzahlen
   Lerne häusliche Umgebungen mit ihren Ecken und Winkeln kennen, während du Teller stapelst, Handtücher aufhängst und Bücherregale anordnest
   Entdecke die Geschichte einer Figur über die Dinge, die sie an jeden neuen Ort mitnimmt (oder aber zurücklässt)
   Soundtrack vom BAFTA-preisgekrönten Komponisten und Tonmeister Jeff van Dyck

Metà puzzle a blocchi e metà decorazione della casa, ti invitiamo a creare uno spazio soddisfacente scoprendo indizi sulla vita che stai tirando fuori dalle scatole.   Caratteristiche:

game.title: Zenless Zone Zero
game.description:
Zenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse, here to provide a thrilling combat experience. Build a squad of up to three and begin your assault with Basic and Special Attacks. Dodge and Parry to neutralize your opponents' counterattacks, and when they're Stunned, unleash a powerful combo of Chain Attacks to finish them off! Remember, different opponents have different traits, and it would be prudent to use their weaknesses to your advantage.

As a professional Proxy, you play a crucial role in linking the city and the Hollows. Your story awaits.
